Aishwarya Sushmita (born 12 July 1995) is an Indian actress.
Early life
Aishwarya Sushmita was born on 12 July 1995 in Darbhanga, Bihar, India.
Career
Sushmita made her debut in 2021 with the web series Special Ops 1.5: The Himmat Story.
In 2016, Aishwarya won the Kingfisher Calendar Supermodels 3, which was shot in Seychelles.
In 2022, She appeared in Runway 34 (2022) and played the character of 'Meeta Devi' in Khakee: The Bihar Chapter (2022).
In 2024, Aishwarya played the role of Kiki in Bad Cop (TV series).
